propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently runs all remaining LLM passes and fails only at sign time after wasting compute and checkpoints keyed to the stale fingerprint
The cancel mechanism must scope to own material only (not relation snapshot or store-wide state) to avoid reintroducing bug d70a false cancels on unrelated ticket writes
Between-pass probes at verify_inputs and coach_inputs check for own-material drift via lightweight single-ticket read under local_read_context, triggering PlanReviewCancelledStale if changed
A cancelled review produces an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding and exits with code 2, never reaching sign or sidecar emit
In-pool chunk workers check the cancel event before invoking runner, returning empty results if the review was cancelled mid-batch
